stations.title: Kwabena
stations.say: Why did the clock stop at 44:59?

stations.title: Session timer
stations.text: Runs every second, all session long.

stations.title: Your fix
stations.gap: Each tick reads an old draw

captions: At Brimwell Lido, Kwabena asks why the session clock sat at 44:59 all morning.
The timer runs every second, and every second the clock shows the same number.
You mend the clock, find the same cause at the gate, and keep it steady, in three tasks.
The ten o'clock session counts down to the whistle, a second at a time.
Same timer, same buttons. The clock and the count now read the newest state.
